### Day 265: Acts 18:24–28
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-265-acts-18-2428.html
Passage: Acts 18:25
Points:
- Paul's obedience in leaving Ephesus made room for Apollos to step into ministry there.
- Failing to say no when God directs can hinder our effectiveness and block others called to serve.
- Apollos was receptive to correction, allowing Priscilla and Aquila to instruct him more accurately.
- Believers must resist the temptation to divide into rival camps over favorite leaders or preaching styles.
- God intentionally uses a wide variety of personalities and gifts to equip and mature His church.
